notes: Authoring source; the game uses the baked intake asset f16_flight.glb (node tools/build-f16-intake.mjs).
f16_cad_high.glb is the original high-detail conversion.
Body_2 is split into its connected CAD solids so the real flaps and rudder can be animated.
The main Body_2 solid keeps its original topology to preserve the intake lip and duct.
The eight supplied missile nodes are detached at load time and reused as mounted/released stores.
Landing gear and missiles remain separate GLB nodes.
